import os,re,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Structure of each demo: block = solid rectangle of 2s. "Stripe region" below it, plus an extension above? Let's inspect per demo:
# For each demo: block bbox; stripes columns; which stripe rows fall where relative to block.
for n in (1,2,3):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0]); main=2; noise_val={1:8,2:3,3:4}[n]
    blockcells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c]==main]
    rs=[r for r,c in blockcells]; cs=[c for r,c in blockcells]
    print(f'--- demo {n}: block rows {min(rs)}-{max(rs)}, cols {min(cs)}-{max(cs)}')
    # stripes outside block rows
    for side in ('above','below'):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if (r<min(rs) if side=='above' else r>max(rs)) and any(O[r][c]==main for c in range(w))]
        cols=sorted({c for r in rows for c in range(w) if O[r][c]==main})
        print(side,'stripe rows',rows,'cols',cols)

import os,re,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for n in (1,2,3):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0]); main=2; nv={1:8,2:3,3:4}[n]
    bcs=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c]==main]
    rs=[r for r,c in bcs]; cs=[c for r,c in bcs]
    br0=min(rs); br1=max(rs); bc0=min(cs); bc1=max(cs)
    print(f'--- demo {n}: block rows {br0}-{br1}, cols {bc0}-{bc1}')
    # show input non-zero cells compact
    print('  IN:')
    for r in range(h):
        print('   ',''.join('.' if I[r][c]==0 else str(I[r][c]) for c in range(w)))
    print('  OUT:')
    for r in range(h):
        print('   ',''.join('.' if O[r][c]==0 else str(O[r][c]) for c in range(w)))

import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for n in (1,2,3):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0]); main=2
    bcs=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c]==main]
    rs=[r for r,c in bcs]; cs=[c for r,c in bcs]
    br0=min(rs); br1=max(rs); bc0=min(cs); bc1=max(cs)
    # block band rows fill extents: for each block row, min and max col of 2 in output
    print(f'--- demo {n}: band rows extents')
    for r in range(br0,br1+1):
        cols=[c for c in range(w) if O[r][c]==main]
        print('  row',r,'cols',min(cols),max(cols),'n=',len(cols))

steps.input:
for n in (1,2,3):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h=len(I); w=len(I[0]); main=[x for r in I for x in r if Counter(r).most_common(1)[0][0] and Counter({x:x for x in r})[list(set(r))][0]]
    # block color = most common nonzero
    from collections import Counter as C
    cnt=C(x for r in I for x in r if x!=0)
    blk=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; nv=[k for k in cnt if k!=blk][-1]
    brs=[r for r in range(h) if any(I[r][c]==blk for c in range(w))]
    bcs_=[c for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c]==blk]
    bc0=min(bcs_); bc1=max(bcs_)
    print(f'--- demo {n}: blk={blk} noise={nv} block rows {min(brs)}-{max(brs)} cols {bc0}-{bc1}')
    fullrows=[r for r in range(h) if sum(O[r][c]==blk for c in range(w))==w and blk in O[r]]
    print('  full-width stripe rows:',fullrows)
    # above noise rows & below noise rows
    above=[r for r in brs if any(I[r][c]==nv for c in range(w))]
    below=[r for r in range(h) if r>max(brs) and any(I[r][c]==nv for c in range(w))]
    print('  input noise rows above:',above,'below:',below)
    # below stripes cols in output
    bstripe=[(r,c) for r in range(max(brs)+1,h) for c in range(w) if O[r][c]==blk]
    bcols=sorted(set(c for r,c in bstripe)); print('  below stripe cols:',bcols[:8])

steps.input:
for n in (1,2,3):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h=len(I); w=len(I[0])
    from collections import Counter as C
    cnt=C(x for r in I for x in r if x!=0)
    blk=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; nv=[k for k in cnt if k!=blk][-1]
    noise=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c]==nv]
    band_rows=[r for r in range(h) if any(I[r][c]==blk for c in range(w))]
    print(f'=== demo {n} blk={blk} noise={nv}')
    for r in band_rows:
        runs=[]; s=None
        for c in range(w):
            if O[r][c]==blk:
                if s is None: s=c
            elif s is not None: runs.append((s,c-1)); s=None
        if s is not None: runs.append((s,w-1))

def analyze(n):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h=len(I); w=len(I[0])
    cnt=C(x for r in I for x in r if x!=0)
    blk=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; nv=[k for k in cnt if k!=blk][-1]
    noise=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c]==nv]
    band_rows=[r for r in range(h) if any(I[r][c]==blk for c in range(w))]
    br0=min(band_rows); br1=max(band_rows)
    bcols_=[c for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c]==blk]
    a=min(bcols_); b=max(bcols_)
    out=[]
    # per outside row: stripe cols
    for r in range(h):
        if r in band_rows: continue
        sc=sorted(set(c for c in range(w) if O[r][c]==blk))
        nins=sorted(set(c for rr,cc in noise if rr==r and a<=cc<=b))
        outs=sorted(set(c for rr,cc in noise if rr==r and not(a<=cc<=b)))
        out.append((r,sc,nins,outs))
    return out,blk,nv,a,b,noise
for n in (1,2,3):
    o,blk,nv,a,b,noise=analyze(n)
    print(f'demo {n} blk={blk} span {a}-{b}')
    for r,sc,nins,outs in o:
        pred=set()
        if nins:
            for c in nins:
                if c<a: pred.add(c+1)   # left noise -> shift right into span
                else: pred.add(c-1)    # right noise -> shift left
        mid=(a+b)//2
        pred|= {mid}
        actual=set(sc)
        print('  row',r,'pred',sorted(pred),'actual',sc,'match',pred==actual)

def solve(In):
    h=len(In); w=len(In[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in In for x in r)
    colors=[v for v in cnt if v!=0]
    band=max(colors,key=lambda v:cnt[v]); noise=[v for v in colors if v!=band][0]
    bcells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if In[r][c]==band]
    L=min(c for r,c in bcells); R=max(c for r,c in bcells)
    brs=sorted(set(r for r,c in bcells))
    Lr,Rr=brs[0],brs[-1]
    O=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            O[r][c]=In[r][c]
    for r in range(Lr,Rr+1):
        noise_in_row=any(In[r][c]==noise for c in range(w))
        if noise_in_row:
            for c in range(L): O[r][c]=band
        else:
            for c in range(w): O[r][c]=band
    # stripes: per region (above/below band rows), band cols NOT occupied by that region's noise cols
    for name,(lo,hi) in [('above',range(0,Lr)),('below',range(Rr+1,h))]:
        nc=sorted({c for r in range(lo,hi+1) for c in range(w) if In[r][c]==noise and L<=c<=R})
        for c in range(L,R+1):
            if c not in nc:
                for r in range(lo,hi+1): O[r][c]=band
    return O

def info(In):
    h=len(In); w=len(In[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in In for x in r)
    band=max(cnt,key=lambda v:cnt[v]); noise=[v for v in cnt if v!=band and v!=0][0]
    bcells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if In[r][c]==band]
    L=min(c for r,c in bcells); R=max(c for r,c in bcells)
    brs=sorted(set(r for r,c in bcells)); Lr,Rr=brs[0],brs[-1]
    ncells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if In[r][c]==noise]
    return band,noise,L,R,Lr,Rr,ncells,h,w

def projections(band,L,R,Lr,Rr,ncells,h,w):
    # each noise pixel: 8 diagonal rays; record first band-cell hit (entry) and last band-cell hit (exit) per ray
    res=[]
    for r,c in ncells:
        pts=[]
        for dr,dc in [(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]:
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc; step=1
            while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                if L<=cc<=R and Lr<=rr<=Rr:
                    pts.append((rr,cc))
                rr+=dr; cc+=dc; step+=1
        res.append(pts)
    return res

for n in (1,2,3):
    In=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; Out=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    band,noise,L,R,Lr,Rr,ncells,h,w=info(In)
    P=projections(band,L,R,Lr,Rr,ncells,h,w)
    stripecols=set()
    fullrows=set()
    for Pts in P:
        if Pts:
            rs={r for r,c in Pts}; cs={c for r,c in Pts}
            stripecols|=cs
            fullrows|=rs
    print(n,'band',L,R,Lr,Rr,'stripes pred cols',sorted(stripecols),'actual',sorted({c for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if Out[r][c]==band and (not (Lr<=r<=Rr) or L<=c<=R)}))
    print('   full rows pred',sorted(fullrows),'actual',sorted({r for r in range(h) if all(Out[r][c]==band for c in range(w))}))

steps.name: ipython
steps.input:
for n in (1,2,3):
    In=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; Out=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h=len(In); w=len(In[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in In for x in r)
    nz=[v for v in cnt if v!=0]; band=max(nz,key=lambda v:cnt[v]); noise=[v for v in nz if v!=band][0]
    bcells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if In[r][c]==band]
    L=min(c for r,c in bcells); R=max(c for r,c in bcells)
    brs=sorted(set(r for r,c in bcells)); Lr,Rr=brs[0],brs[-1]
    print('=== Demo',n,'band rows',Lr,Rr,'cols',L,R,'noise pxs:',[(r,c) for r,c in [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if In[r][c]==noise]])

def analyze(n, mode='entry'):
    In=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; Out=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h=len(In); w=len(In[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in In for x in r)
    nz=[v for v in cnt if v!=0]; band=max(nz,key=lambda v:cnt[v]); noise=[v for v in nz if v!=band][0]
    bcells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if In[r][c]==band]
    L=min(c for r,c in bcells); R=max(c for r,c in bcells)
    brs=sorted(set(r for r,c in bcells)); Lr,Rr=brs[0],brs[-1]
    npx=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if In[r][c]==noise]
    def inband(r,c): return Lr<=r<=Rr and L<=c<=R
    res=set()
    for (r0,c0) in npx:
        for dr,dc in [(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]:
            r,c=r0+dr,c0+dc
            entered=False
            while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
                if inband(r,c) and not entered:
                    res.add(c)
                    entered=True
                elif not inband(r,c) and entered:
                    break
                r+=dr; c+=dc
    act=sorted({c for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if Out[r][c]==band and not(Lr<=r<=Rr)})
    return sorted(res), act, (L,R,Lr,Rr,npx)
for n in (1,2,3):
    pred,act,bbox=npx=None
    pred,act,_=analyze(n)
    print(n,'pred',pred,'actual',act,'match',pred==act)

def band_info(n):
    In=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']
    h=len(In); w=len(In[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in In for x in r)
    nz=[v for v in cnt if v!=0]; band=max(nz,key=lambda v:cnt[v]); noise=[v for v in nz if v!=band][0]
    bcells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if In[r][c]==band]
    L=min(c for r,c in bcells); R=max(c for r,c in bcells)
    brs=sorted(set(r for r,c in bcells)); Lr,Rr=brs[0],brs[-1]
    return h,w,L,R,Lr,Rr,band,noise
res={}
for n in (1,2,3):
    h,w,L,R,Lr,Rr,bn=noise=band_info(n)
    res[n]=(h,w,L,R,Lr,Rr,bn,noise)
    print(n,res[n][:6], bn, noise)

import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def info(In):
    h=len(In); w=len(In[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in In for x in r)
    nz=[v for v in cnt if v!=0]
    band=max(nz,key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    noise=[v for v in nz if v!=band][0]
    bcells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if In[r][c]==band]
    L=min(c for r,c in bcells); R=max(c for r,c in bcells)
    brs=sorted(set(r for r,c in bcells)); Lr,Rr=brs[0],brs[-1]
    return h,w,L,R,Lr,Rr,band,noise,bcells
for n in (1,2,3):
    In=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; Out=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h,w,L,R,Lr,Rr,band,noise,bcells=info(In)
    add=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if Out[r][c]==2 and In[r][c]!=2]
    rem=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if In[r][c]!=0 and Out[r][c]==0]
    pt=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if In[r][c]==noise]
    print('demo',n,'band',band,'noise',noise,'band rows',Lr,Rr,'cols',L,R)
    print('  added:',len(add),'of rows',sorted({r for r,c in add}))
    print('  stripe cols added:',sorted({c for r,c in add}))
    print('  removed noise:',rem)
    print('  noise pts:',pt)

from collections import Counter
def f(I):
    h=len(I); w=len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r if x!=0)
    band=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; noise=[v for v in cnt if v!=band][0]
    bcells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c]==band]
    Lr,Rr=min(r for r,_ in bcells),max(r for r,_ in bcells)
    BL,BR=min(c for _,c in bcells),max(c for _,c in bcells)
    On=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c]==noise]
    # sides
    def singles(cols):
        return {c for c in cols if cols.count(c)==1}
    above_noises={(r,c) for r,c in On if r<Lr}; below_noises={(r,c) for r,c in On if r>Rr}
    A=singles({c for r,c in above_noises}) & set(range(BL,BR+1))
    B=singles({c for r,c in below_noises}) & set(range(BL,BR+1))
    span=set(range(BL,BR+1))
    stripes_above=span - {c for r,c in [(r,c) for r,c in On if BL<=c<=BR]} | A
    stripes_below=span - {c for r,c in [(r,c) for r,c in On if BL<=c<=BR]} | B
    Out=[row[:] for row in I]
    for r in range(Lr,Rr+1):
        for c in range(w): Out[r][c]=band
    for r in range(Lr):
        for c in stripes_above: Out[r][c]=band
    for r in range(Rr+1,h):
        for c in stripes_below: Out[r][c]=band
    return Out

import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for d in (1,2,3):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {d} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt={}
    for r in gi:
        for x in r: cnt[x]=cnt.get(x,0)+1
    bg=max(cnt,key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    others=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    band=max(others,key=lambda v:cnt[v]); noise=min(others,key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    brows=[r for r in range(h) if any(gi[r][c]==band for c in range(w))]
    bcols=[c for c in range(w) if any(gi[r][c]==band for r in brows)]
    bl,bt=min(brows),max(brows); bc0,bc1=min(bcols),max(bcols)
    npts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==noise]
    # output: classify rows outside band: does each have bands, and which cols
    srows=[r for r in range(h) if r not in brows]
    scol=set()
    for r in srows:
        for c in range(w):
            if go[r][c]==band: scol.add(c)
    info=[]
    for (r,c) in npts:
        dr = 'A' if r<bl else ('B' if r>bt else 'I')
        dc = 'L' if c<bc0 else ('R' if c>bc1 else '.')
        info.append((dr,dc,r,c))
    print('=== demo',d,'bandrows',bl,bt,'bandcols',bc0,bc1,'bandcols-count',bc1-bc0+1)
    print('  noise rel:',info)
    print('  stripe cols out:',sorted(scol))
    # also stripe cols restricted to band column span
    scol_in=scol & set(range(bc0,bc1+1))
    print('  stripe cols in band span:',sorted(scol_in))

import itertools
def data(d):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {d} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt={}
    for r in gi:
        for x in r: cnt[x]=cnt.get(x,0)+1
    bg=max(cnt,key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    others=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    band=max(others,key=lambda v:cnt[v]); noise=min(others,key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    brows=[r for r in range(h) if any(gi[r][c]==band for c in range(w))]
    bcols=[c for c in range(w) if any(gi[r][c]==band for r in brows)]
    bc0,bc1=min(bcols),max(bcols)
    Nbelow=sorted({c for r,c in [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==noise and r>max(brows)]})

steps.input:
for d in (1,2,3):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {d} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
    cnt={}
    for r in gi:
        for x in r: cnt[x]=cnt.get(x,0)+1
    bg=max(cnt,key=lambda v:cnt[v]); band=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg][0]; noise=[v for v in cnt if v not in (bg,band)][0]
    brows=[r for r in range(h) if any(v==band for v in gi[r])]
    bcs=[c for c in range(w) if any(gi[r][c]==band for r in brows)]
    bl,bc=min(bcs),max(bcs); bw=bc-bl+1
    # noise offsets in each region (relative to band start col, positive right)
    na=sorted({(c-bl)%bw for r in range(brows[0]) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==noise})
    nb=sorted({(c-bl)%bw for r in range(brows[-1]+1,h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==noise})
    nm=sorted({(c-bl)%bw for r in brows for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==noise})
    Sa=sorted(c-bw0 for c in {c for r in range(brows[0]) for c in range(w) if go[r][c]==band}-set(range(w)) and True for c in {c for r in range(brows[0]) for c in range(w) if go[r][c]==band})
    Sa=sorted({c-bw for c in {c for r in range(brows[0]) for c in range(w) if go[r][c]==band}}) if False else sorted({c-bw for c in {c for r in range(brows[0]) for c in range(w) if go[r][c]==band}})
    S_mid=sorted({c for r in brows for c in range(w) if go[r][c]==band and c not in bcs})
    print('demo',d,'bw',bw,'band_abs',[bl,bc],'above_noisy_offs',na,'mid_noise_offs',nm)
    print('   above_stripes_rel',sorted({c-bw for c in Sa})) if False else print('   above_stripes_abs',Sa,'rel',sorted({c-bl for c in Sa}))
    print('   mid_added_abs',S_mid,'rel',sorted({c-bl for c in S_mid}))

# Clean reload and feature table
import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for d in (1,2,3):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {d} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
    cnt={}
    for r in gi:
        for x in r: cnt[x]=cnt.get(x,0)+1
    bg=max(cnt,key=lambda v:cnt[v]); band=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg][0]; noise=[v for v in cnt if v not in (bg,band)][0]
    brows=[r for r in range(h) if any(v==band for v in gi[r])]
    brs,bre=brows[0],brows[-1]
    bcs=[c for c in range(w) if any(gi[r][c]==band for r in brows)]
    bl,bc=min(bcs),max(bcs); bw=bc-bl+1
    def rel(c): return (c-bl)%bw
    # stripe sets: rows strictly outside band, cell==band
    Sab=sorted(rel(c) for r in range(brs) for c in range(w) if go[r][c]==band)
    Sb=sorted(rel(c) for r in range(bre+1,h) for c in range(w) if go[r][c]==band)
    N_a=sorted(rel(c) for r in range(brs) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==noise)
    N_b=sorted(rel(c) for r in range(bre+1,h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==noise)
    N_m=sorted(rel(c) for r in brows for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==noise)
    print('demo',d,'bw',bw,'N_a',N_a,'N_b',N_b,'N_m',N_m,'stripesA',Sab,'stripesB',Sb)

import os,re
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
for d in (1,2,3):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {d} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
    cnt={}
    for r in gi:
        for x in r: cnt[x]=cnt.get(x,0)+1
    bg=max(cnt,key=lambda v:cnt[v]); band=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg][0]; noise=[v for v in cnt if v not in (bg,band)][0]
    noisei=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==noise]
    noiseo=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if go[r][c]==noise]
    twoi={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==2}
    twoo={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if go[r][c]==2}
    print('=== demo',d,'bg',bg,'band',band,'noise',noise)
    print(' noise moved:',sorted(set(noisei)-set(noiseo)), sorted(set(noiseo)-set(noisei)))
    # added 2 cells (not in input band region? list all added, grouped by row)
    add=sorted(twoo-twow:=None) if False else sorted(twoo-twi for twi in [])  # placeholder
    add=sorted(twoo - twoi)
    rem=sorted(twi - twoo)
    print(' added2 rows:', sorted({r for r,c in add}))
    print(' removed2 rows:', sorted({r for r,c in rem}))
    # by column
    addc=sorted({c for r,c in add})
    remc=sorted({c for r,c in rem})
    print(' added cols:',addc,'removed cols:',remc)

import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
nm='Demo pair 1'
gi=G[nm+' input']; go=G[nm+' output']
h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])

brows=[r for r in range(h) if any(v==2 for v in gi[r])]
bcs=[c for c in range(w) if any(v==2 for v in gi[r] for r in [brows[0]])]
for r in range(h):
    line=''.join(str(x) if x else '.' for x in gi[r])
    print(line,'|',''.join(str(x) if x else '.' for x in go[r]))

    paints={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if go[r][c]==band and gi[r][c]!=band}

import collections

def solve(gi):
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for r in gi for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    band=None;noise=None
    for v in others:
        runs=sum(r.count(v) for r in gi)
        dots=sum(1 for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==v and (r==0 or gi[r-1][c]!=v) and (r==h-1 or gi[r+1][c]!=v) and (c==0 or gi[r][c-1]!=v) and (c==w-1 or gi[r][c+1]!=v))
        if dots==0: band=v
        elif dots>0: noise=v
    brows=[r for r in range(h) if gi[r].count(band)>0]
    bcs=[c for c in range(w) if any(gi[r][c]==band for r in brows)]
    bl,bc=min(bcs),max(bcs)
    r0,r1=min(brows),max(brows)
    D=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==noise]
    pred=[row[:] for row in gi]
    def paint_rect(r0,r1,c0,c1):
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                if pred[r][c]==bg: pred[r][c]=band
    # top: rows 0..r0-1, exclude cols containing a dot above band
    exc_top=sorted({c for r,c in D if r<r0})
    for c in exc_top: paint_rect(None,None,c,c) if False else None
    # simpler: paint whole strip then erase excluded cols
    for sid,(rr0,rr1,cc0,cc1,excl_axis) in [('top',0,r0-1,bl,bc,'col'),
                                            ('bot',r1+1,h-1,bl,bc,'col'),
                                            ('lft',0,h-1,0,bl-1,'row'),
                                            ('rgt',0,h-1,bc+1,w-1,'row')]:
        excl=set()
        if excl_axis=='col':
            excl=sorted({c for r,c in D if r<rr0 if sid=='top' else r>rr1})
        else:
            excl=sorted({r for r,c in D if c<cc0 if sid=='lft' else c>cc1})
        reg=[r for r in range(rr0,rr1+1) if r not in (None,)][:0]  # placeholder
        # paint full strip then remove excluded lines
        for r in range(rr0,rr1+1):
            for c in range(cc0,cc1+1):
                if pred[r][c]==bg: pred[r][c]=band
        for r in range(rr0,rr1+1):
            for c in excl:
                if pred[r][c]==band: pred[r][c]=bg
    return pred

allok=True

def naiv(f,gi,out):
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for r in gi for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band=max([(v,cnt[v]) for v in cnt if v!=bg],key=lambda t:t[1])[0]
    noise=[v for v in cnt if v not in (bg,band)][0]
    brs=[r for r in range(h) if any(gi[r][c]==band for c in range(w))]
    bcs=[c for c in range(w) if any(gi[r][c]==band for r in brs)]
    r0,r1=min(brs),max(brs); bl,bc=min(bcs),max(bcs)
    D=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==noise]
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]
    def paint(rr0,rr1,cc0,cc1):
        for r in range(max(0,rr0),min(h,rr1+1)):
            for c in range(max(0,cc0),min(w,cc1+1)):
                if g[r][c]==bg: g[r][c]=band
    # candidate rules: try variants of strip extents & exclusion sets
    return None

    noise=[v for v in cnt if v not in (bg,band)][0]
    brs=[r for r in range(h) if any(gi[r][c]==band for c in range(w))]

def f(gi):
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for r in gi for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band=max([(v,cnt[v]) for v in cnt if v!=bg],key=lambda t:t[1])[0]
    noise=[v for v in cnt if v not in (bg,band)][0]
    brs=[r for r in range(h) if any(gi[r][c]==band for c in range(w))]
    bcs=[c for c in range(w) if any(gi[r][c]==band for r in brs)]
    r0,r1=min(brs),max(brs); c0,c1=min(bcs),max(bcs)
    D=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==noise]
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]
    def paint(rr0,rr1,cc0,cc1,exclude=None):
        for r in range(max(0,rr0),min(h,rr1+1)):
            for c in range(max(0,cc0),min(w,cc1+1)):
                if g[r][c]==bg and exclude is None or (c not in exclude if cc0<=c<=c1 else r not in exclude):
                    g[r][c]=band
    # exclude sets: columns for top/bottom (dots in band span, outside band rows); rows for left/right
    tc=sorted({c for r,c in D if r<r0 and c0<=c<=c1})
    bc_ex=sorted({c for r,c in D if r>r1 and c0<=c<=c1})
    lc=sorted({r for r,c in D if c<c0 and r0<=r<=r1})
    rc=sorted({r for r,c in D if c>c1 and r0<=r<=r1})
    paint(0,r0-1,c0,c1,tc)
    paint(r1+1,h-1,c0,c1,bc_ex)
    paint(0,h-1,0,c0-1,lc)
    paint(0,h-1,c1+1,w-1,rc)
    return g

def f(gi):
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for r in gi for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band=max([(v,cnt[v]) for v in cnt if v!=bg],key=lambda t:t[1])[0]
    noise=[v for v in cnt if v not in (bg,band)][0]
    brs=[r for r in range(h) if any(gi[r][c]==band for c in range(w))]
    bcs=[c for c in range(w) if any(gi[r][c]==band for r in brs)]
    r0,r1=min(brs),max(brs); c0,c1=min(bcs),max(bcs)
    D=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==noise]
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]
    # rays: up/down use band cols, left/right use band rows; exclude dots on same side
    def paint(rr0,rr1,cc0,cc1,excl):
        for r in range(max(0,rr0),min(h,rr1+1)):
            for c in range(max(0,cc0),min(w,cc1+1)):
                if g[r][c]==bg and r not in excl: g[r][c]=band
    uc=sorted({c for r,c in D if r<r0 and c0<=c<=c1}); dc=sorted({c for r,c in D if r>r1 and c0<=c<=c1})
    lr=sorted({r for r,c in D if c<c0 and r0<=r<=r1}); rr=sorted({r for r,c in D if c>c1 and r0<=r<=r1})
    paint(0,r0-1,c0,c1,None)      # up
    paint(r1+1,h-1,c0,c1,dc)      # down
    paint(0,h-1,0,c0-1,lr)        # left
    paint(0,h-1,c1+1,w-1,rr)      # right
    return g
allok=all(f(G[nm+' input'])==G[nm+' output'] for nm in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3'))
print('all ok:',allok)

    import json; print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
